verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability and improvement SaaS, so a separate sandbox or test environment is a fair thing to ask about. However, no sandbox, test project, or isolated environment is documented. Shadow mode runs on live production traffic, and offline/CI evaluation scores releases against production history; both are adjacent features, not isolation from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
